title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

in_flight.description: Events admitted and not yet finished.

problem.description: Why its current settings do not build, when they do not; its allowlists are then unknown.

source.description: Where its value is: set in the panel, which wins; an environment variable of the name; or missing, when settings refer to a name set in neither.

restarted.description: The modules rebuilt with the change.

applies.description: When a saved revision takes effect: now, as it is saved, or restart, when the process next starts.

client_secret_set.description: Whether the client secret is set; the secret itself is not reported.

action.description: The event's action, such as message.created.

cursor.description: Pass as before for the tasks older than this one.

outcome.description: running while a module handles it; otherwise the worst outcome among its records.

started.description: When the work of its first record began.

text.description: The event's message as plain text.

running.description: Its deliveries running now; the event is finished when there are none.
